title: Outlook: Sort your subfolders from A to Z
description: You'll be able to sort a folder's subfolders alphabetically from the parent folder. This makes it easier to find the folder you need without rearranging subfolders one by one. It's a simple way to keep long folder lists organized. #newoutlookforwindows
